lines.text: I know this. I have read it over the dead.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: The pages are blank.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Eavesdropper. The one who hears what is said at the gate.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Those were Anpu's words on the road.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Eavesdropper.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: This one has no name written. It lies on its face, like the dead before the washing.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Who are they? The grey ones, in the far fields. They never look up.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The Field That Waits.

lines.text: The water cannot climb to the basin.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The Field That Waits.

lines.text: The basin is full. The bud will not open.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The Field That Waits.

lines.text: He is clay. He will fall and break, and you will cry.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The Field That Waits. This line is a memory, heard as if from far away.

lines.text: Hori. His falcon. I had forgotten the falcon.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The Field That Waits.

lines.text: Then what am I required to do?
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door.

lines.text: The seedlings are drowning. The upper sluice is jammed open.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door.

lines.text: It drains, and the water above tears at the roots instead.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door.

lines.text: I did not answer him. I wanted him to see that I was angry. Then the door shut.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door. This line is a memory, heard as if from far away.

lines.text: He did not come back. I have hated that word since. Khetem. Seal.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door. This line is a memory, heard as if from far away.

lines.text: It held.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: The House With One Door.

lines.text: Three plots, three sluices, and the canal brimming behind them. Who keeps it so full?
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.

lines.text: Too much. The canal is too full.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.

lines.text: This one has my name.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.

lines.text: It has not stopped.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.

lines.text: I made it to work so I could rest. I never rested.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.

lines.text: She shouted it. She shouted my name at the gods.
lines.context: Ankhu, a dead funerary priest, newly woken in the afterlife. Quiet, grave, plain-spoken, carrying old grief. Scene: Shabti Row.
